definitions.explanation: A self-governing administrative body at the regional or local level. In Japan, this includes prefectures (都道府県) and municipalities (市町村). Frequently encountered in news and official contexts.

examples.japanese: {自治体|じちたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{補助金|ほじょきん}→補助金：19222_hojokin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: The local government provides a subsidy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧{自治体|じちたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{分別|ぶんべつ}→分別：07706_bunbetsu⟧⟦ルール→ルール：00354_ruuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{定|さだ}めている→定める：10448_sadameru⟧。
examples.english: Each municipality sets its own rules for garbage separation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少子化|しょうしか}→少子化：04807_shoushika⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自治体|じちたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{子育|こそだ}て→子育て：12226_kosodate⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}→充実：04845_juujitsu⟧⟦させている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As a countermeasure to the declining birth rate, many municipalities are enhancing their childcare support.

notes:
USAGE:
{自治体|じちたい} is a common word in news, politics, and daily life. Japan's local government system has two layers: ⟦{都道府県|とどうふけん}→都道府県：14502_todoufuken⟧ (prefectures) and ⟦{市町村|しちょうそん}→市町村：16065_shichouson⟧ (cities, towns, and villages). {自治体|じちたい} can refer to either level. The formal legal term is {地方公共団体|ちほうこうきょうだんたい}, but {自治体|じちたい} is the everyday word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地方|ちほう}{自治体|じちたい}: local government
- ⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧{自治体|じちたい}: each municipality
- {自治体|じちたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}み→取り組み：10403_torikumi⟧: municipal initiatives
- {自治体|じちたい}⟦{職員|しょくいん}→職員：20206_shokuin⟧: municipal employee
